summary: Titan Mining Corp furnished a Form 6-K (US equivalent of a foreign private issuer current report) attaching a September 9, 2026 press release updating permitting progress for its Kilbourne Graphite Project at the Empire State Mine in St. Lawrence County, New York. The company reported that the U.S. Army Corps of Engineers substantially completed the Section 404 Clean Water Act public comment period, cultural resources submissions advanced to the State Historic Preservation Office, and a Biological Assessment is being finalized for U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service consultation. A Joint Application was submitted to the New York State Department of Environmental Conservation; design optimization since April 2026 cut wetland impact footprint roughly 50%, with commercial-scale graphite production targeted for 2028 and federal permits targeted by August 2027. No securities, transaction terms, board recommendation, or advisor were disclosed; this is a routine operational/permitting update rather than a special situation.
